SHOP_REQUIRED: Shift scheduling belongs to a shop — this account is not attached to one
OPENING_HOURS_INCOMPLETE: Send all 7 days, one for each weekday from Sunday to Saturday
INVALID_OPENING_HOURS: Opening and closing time are the same. For a day open around the clock use 00:00 to 24:00, or mark the day closed
INVALID_TIMEZONE: "{timezone}" is not a valid timezone name
SLOT_LIMIT_REACHED: This day already has {max} shifts. Remove one before adding another
DAY_CLOSED: The shop is closed on this day. Set its opening hours before adding a shift
OUTSIDE_OPENING_HOURS: The shift must fit inside this day's opening hours ({open} to {close})
SLOTS_OVERLAP: This shift overlaps "{name}". Shifts on the same day must not overlap
INVALID_SLOT_WINDOW: Start and end time are the same — the shift would have no length
ASSIGNEE_NOT_EMPLOYEE: User {userId} cannot be assigned — assignees must be active employees of this shop
SESSION_ALREADY_OPEN: {name}'s shift is still open. Count the drawer and close it before starting a new shift
